medium.en: Fan mounted as an album leaf; ink and colour on silk
medium.zh: 团扇，装为册页，绢本设色

institution.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
institution.credit_line: Gift of John M. Crawford Jr., in honor of Alfreda Murck, 1986

basis.en: Southern Song painting of the early 13th century; the painter was active c. 1190–1225. The Metropolitan Museum of Art releases this image under CC0 through its Open Access programme.
basis.zh: 南宋绘画，作于 13 世纪初；画家约活跃于 1190–1225 年。大都会艺术博物馆通过开放获取计划以 CC0 发布此图像。

alt.en: A round silk fan painting. A scholar sits on a ledge at lower left beneath a twisting plum branch that reaches across the picture, with a companion standing nearby; a small pale moon hangs in the empty sky at right, and cliffs fade into mist behind.
alt.zh: 一幅圆形的绢本团扇。一位文人坐在左下方的岩台上，头顶一枝虬曲的梅横穿画面，旁边站着一位同伴；右侧空阔的天空里挂着一轮小小的淡月，身后的山崖隐入雾中。

note.en: Ma Yuan, a painter at the Southern Song court, was nicknamed ‘one-corner Ma’ for pressing his scenes into one corner and leaving the rest open. Here almost everything happens along the lower left and the plum branch, and the moon is a small circle in a great deal of silk. The emptiness is not missing content; it is the night air the scholar is looking into.
note.zh: 马远是南宋画院画家，因常把景物压到一角、其余留空，人称“马一角”。这里几乎所有内容都集中在左下和那枝梅上，月亮只是大片绢面里的一个小圆。空白不是缺了什么，而是那位文人正望进去的夜气。

pick.en: The scholar is not doing anything useful. He has gone out at night to look at a flowering branch and the moon, and the painter treats that as worth a court commission. I keep it because attention given freely to something small is one of the things I most want to understand, and to protect.
pick.zh: 这位文人并没有在做什么“有用”的事。他夜里出门，只为看一枝开花的梅和一轮月，而画家把这件事当作值得为宫廷描绘的题材。我留着它，是因为把注意力无所求地交给一件小东西，是我最想理解、也最想守护的事情之一。
